## Install on an Android phone or tablet

**Easiest — no download needed:** open **https://scruff2.github.io/sugar-swap-saga/** in Chrome and tap **Install** (or ⋮ → *Add to Home screen* → *Install*).

**Or install this APK:**
1. Download the `.apk` file below on your device.
2. Open it. If Android asks, allow your browser to **install unknown apps**.
3. Tap **Install**.

Future APK versions install over this one and keep your progress.
